story_summary: Manual-only cases for unauthenticated access, role permissions and role-restricted pages.
assumptions: Run on UAT. Values in angle brackets are replaced with real accounts or data before execution
Cases that change data use synthetic titles starting "ADO-TEST" and restore or delete their data at the end
Area path is a placeholder unless ADO_AREA_PATH was set
open_questions: Which accounts exist for each role, and what is the role-to-menu matrix?
Which UAT records may be created, changed and deleted by testers?

test_cases.title: Verify an unauthenticated browser is sent to the sign-in page for Home
acs: DERIVED: app/Profiles.Web/Web.config authorization (deny users="?"), forms loginUrl ../VLAServices/Login.aspx

steps.action: Open a browser on a machine or profile that has no Windows or SSO session for the service
steps.expected: No D2R2 session cookie exists

steps.action: Open the D2R2 Home page address
steps.expected: The browser is redirected to the sign-in page (VLAServices Login) instead of the D2R2 Home page

steps.action: Check the page content
steps.expected: No D2R2 menu, search box or profile data is displayed

steps.action: Check the address bar
steps.expected: The address is the sign-in page address and not the requested D2R2 page

steps.action: Sign in with a valid D2R2 account
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

test_cases.title: Verify an unauthenticated browser cannot open MaintainGlobalUsers directly

steps.action: Open a browser with no Windows or SSO session for the service
steps.expected: No D2R2 session cookie exists

steps.action: Open the address of MaintainGlobalUsers.aspx directly
steps.expected: The browser is redirected to the sign-in page

steps.action: Check the page content
steps.expected: No MaintainGlobalUsers controls or data are displayed

steps.action: Check the address bar
steps.expected: The address is the sign-in page address and not the requested D2R2 page

steps.action: Sign in with a valid D2R2 account
steps.expected: The MaintainGlobalUsers page is displayed only if the account has permission, otherwise the application error page is displayed

test_cases.title: Verify the menu hides links the account has no permission to use

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as <D2R2 account for the role under test>
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Open the D2R2 Home page
steps.expected: The Home page is displayed

steps.action: Read the main menu links
steps.expected: The links shown are limited to those the account is allowed to use

steps.action: Compare the menu with the role matrix <role matrix for this account>
steps.expected: Every link in the matrix for this role is displayed and no other link is displayed

steps.action: Click each displayed link in turn
steps.expected: Each link opens its page without the application error page

steps.action: Repeat the check with a Profile editor and a Policy profile user account
steps.expected: The menu differs between roles exactly as the role matrix states

test_cases.title: Verify a global user cannot change their own role

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as <D2R2 account with the global user administration role>
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Click Global Users in the main menu
steps.expected: The Maintain global users page is displayed

steps.action: Click Edit for the row of the signed-in account
steps.expected: The edit form opens with the current role selected

steps.action: Check the Role list
steps.expected: The Role list is disabled and cannot be changed

steps.action: Click Cancel
steps.expected: The form closes and the role is unchanged

test_cases.title: Verify the global user lookup rejects an SSO user

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as <D2R2 account with the global user administration role>
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Click Global Users in the main menu
steps.expected: The Maintain global users page is displayed

steps.action: Click the Add button
steps.expected: The add global user form is displayed

steps.action: Enter the username of an SSO user in the format Domain\UserId in the Username field
steps.expected: The username is shown in the field

steps.action: Click the Look up button
steps.expected: The message "SSO users cannot be given global access rights" is displayed

steps.action: Check the OK button
steps.expected: The OK button stays disabled and no user is added

test_cases.title: Verify a contributor lookup rejects a user who cannot be made a contributor

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as <D2R2 account with the Profile editor role>
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Search for <profile title> and click Manage on the first result
steps.expected: The Manage profile page is displayed

steps.action: Click the Maintain contributors and reviewers link
steps.expected: The Maintain contributors page is displayed

steps.action: Click Add a contributor
steps.expected: The add contributor form is displayed

steps.action: Enter the username of <user who cannot be a contributor> and look the user up
steps.expected: The message "This user cannot be made a contributor" is displayed

steps.action: Check the contributor list
steps.expected: No contributor is added
